---
title: "Where does the ballast go, and how much?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

The neutral point from a straight-line fit of `Cm` against `CL` over α = 0–8° at
6 m/s, then the ballast mass that puts the CG a given static margin ahead of it.

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed
Static margin is not something the plan specifies, so three values are carried
rather than one. The fit band is a choice too, not a measurement.
:::

```{python}
mp0 = mass_properties()
x_np = neutral_point(band=(0, 8), V=6.0)

margins = [0.05, 0.10, 0.15]
x_b = np.linspace(0, x_le_w, 200)
m_b = {SM: ballast_for(x_np - SM * c_w, x_b, mp0) for SM in margins}

nose = {SM: ballast_for(x_np - SM * c_w, 0.0, mp0) for SM in margins}
le = {SM: ballast_for(x_np - SM * c_w, x_le_w, mp0) for SM in margins}
DIME = 2.268e-3                      # kg, a US dime, the plan's own ballast
dime = mass_properties(m_ballast=DIME, x_ballast=0.0)
```

**Answer.** On the nose, and about `{python} f"{nose[0.10]*1e3:.0f}"` g of it.
Unballasted the airframe is unstable — `{python} f"{mp0.mass*1e3:.2f}"` g of
foam puts the CG `{python} f"{mp0.x_cg*1e3:.1f}"` mm aft of the nose against a
neutral point at `{python} f"{x_np*1e3:.1f}"` mm, a static margin of
`{python} f"{static_margin(mp0.x_cg, x_np)*100:+.0f}"`% MAC — because a
stabilizer `{python} f"{S_h/S_w*100:.0f}"`% the area of the wing, plus the fin,
sit at the end of a `{python} f"{l_fus*100:.1f}"` cm fuselage. Station matters
more than the mass does: 10% MAC costs `{python} f"{nose[0.10]*1e3:.2f}"` g at
the nose but `{python} f"{le[0.10]*1e3:.2f}"` g at the wing leading edge, where
the plan says to tape the dime (@fig-ballast). A dime alone is not enough at
this size; `{python} f"{DIME*1e3:.2f}"` g on the nose lands the CG at `{python} f"{dime.x_cg*1e3:.1f}"` mm,
`{python} f"{(x_np - dime.x_cg)*1e3:.1f}"` mm ahead of the neutral point, which
is under half a percent of MAC and stable in name only.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ballast
#| tbl-cap: "Ballast needed at each static margin, taped to the nose and taped at the wing leading edge, at 6 m/s."
import pandas as pd

pd.DataFrame({
    "static margin [% MAC]": [SM * 100 for SM in margins],
    "target CG [mm]": [(x_np - SM * c_w) * 1e3 for SM in margins],
    "on the nose [g]": [nose[SM] * 1e3 for SM in margins],
    "at the wing LE [g]": [le[SM] * 1e3 for SM in margins],
}).style.format({
    "static margin [% MAC]": "{:.0f}", "target CG [mm]": "{:.1f}",
    "on the nose [g]": "{:.2f}", "at the wing LE [g]": "{:.2f}",
}).hide(axis="index")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-ballast
#| fig-cap: "Ballast mass needed against the station it is taped to, from the nose back to the wing leading edge. The dashed line marks the 2.27 g of the dime the plan calls for."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

for SM in margins:
    ax.plot(x_b * 1e3, m_b[SM] * 1e3, label=f"static margin {SM:.0%} MAC")

ax.axhline(DIME * 1e3, ls="--", c="0.4", lw=1,
           label=f"a dime, {DIME*1e3:.2f} g")
ax.set_xlabel("ballast station [mm aft of the nose]")
ax.set_ylabel("ballast mass [g]")
ax.set_xlim(0, x_le_w * 1e3)
ax.set_ylim(0, 15)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
